Create custom keywords to encapsulate reusable test logic
Organize complete test suites with Settings, Variables, Test Cases, and Keywords sections
Debug and fix common spacing and formatting errors

keyTakeaways: Robot Framework uses whitespace (4 spaces) as its primary syntax delimiter
Test case content must be indented exactly 4 spaces from the test name
Keywords and arguments are separated by 4+ spaces (4 is standard)
The Log keyword outputs messages for debugging and verification
Variables use ${variable_name} syntax and are assigned with Set Variable
Assertions like Should Be Equal validate expected outcomes
[Documentation] and [Tags] provide test metadata for organization
Custom keywords encapsulate reusable logic and improve maintainability
Complete suites have four optional sections: Settings, Variables, Test Cases, Keywords
Consistent formatting is critical—use tools like robotidy to automate
commonPitfalls: Using tabs instead of spaces for indentation
Inconsistent spacing (2 spaces, 6 spaces instead of 4)
Forgetting to indent test case content
Commenting out code without cleaning up later
Writing comments that restate code instead of explaining why
Mixing different data formats (space, tab, pipe) in same file
